info.name: OpenBuild ⇄ NL Design Theme Asset Contract
info.description:
Newman/Postman contract suite for the nldesign-theme-selection feature (REQ-NTS-006). OpenBuild is a pure read-only consumer (ADR-022) of nldesign's EXISTING surface — it adds NO PHP. This collection pins exactly what openbuild reads so nldesign-side drift fails CI:

  1. GET <static>/apps/nldesign/css/tokens/rijkshuisstijl.css — the ONLY call the runtime applier (useAppTheme) ever makes. Asserts 200, a text/css-ish content type, a `:root` rule, and the `--nldesign-color-primary` variable the applier scopes. This is the de-facto consumable contract (the very file nldesign injects globally).
  2. GET /apps/nldesign/settings/tokensets as ADMIN — the builder picker's primary list source. Asserts 200 + an array containing `rijkshuisstijl` WHEN the admin list is reachable (the route is AuthorizedAdminSetting(Admin::class); admin:admin satisfies it).
  3. GET /apps/nldesign/settings/tokensets as NON-ADMIN — DOCUMENTS TODAY'S REALITY: 401/403, because every nldesign settings/* route is AuthorizedAdminSetting(Admin::class) (verified 2026-06-15). This is the flagged dependency: openbuild's non-admin builders fall back to the validated free-text path until nldesign ships a #[NoAdminRequired] read-only list endpoint. When that lands, flip this assertion to 200 and add the array-shape check.

AUTH MODEL mirrors the other openbuild collections: noauth collection auth + explicit basic-auth per request; the non-admin request uses the `viewerUser`/`viewerPass` variables (set to a non-admin account in CI) and targets the 127.0.0.1 host so the admin session cookie is host-scoped away from it. With no non-admin account configured the non-admin probe asserts 401 (unauthenticated), which is also a correct 'no non-admin read' outcome.

The collection is tolerant of a stock instance: the asset request always asserts; the admin-list request asserts its shape only when 200 (an empty/!installed nldesign skips with a note, never faking a pass). Run via run-newman.sh.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 404) { pm.test('skipped — nldesign / rijkshuisstijl asset not present on this instance', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true); return; }
pm.test('asset defines --nldesign-color-primary (the variable the applier scopes)', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('--nldesign-color-primary'));

item.name: 2. tokensets as ADMIN (200 + contains rijkshuisstijl, when reachable)

exec: if (pm.response.code !== 200) { pm.test('admin token-set list not reachable on this instance — skipped (status ' + pm.response.code + ')', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true); return; }
let body; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { body = null; }
const list = body && (body.results || body.tokenSets || body.sets || body);

item.name: 3. tokensets as NON-ADMIN (401/403 today — flagged dependency)

exec: // All of nldesign settings/* is AuthorizedAdminSetting(Admin::class) today,
// so a non-admin (or unauthenticated) caller cannot list token sets — openbuild
// falls back to the validated free-text path. Flip to 200 + array-shape when the
// flagged #[NoAdminRequired] list endpoint lands in nldesign.
pm.test('non-admin token-set list is denied (401/403) — documents the flagged dependency', () => pm.expect([401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));
